name: Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD)
source: TCFD Final Recommendations (June 2017); ISSB IFRS S2 (supersedes TCFD from 2024)
notes: TCFD has been absorbed into IFRS S2 Climate Disclosures (2024). ESRS E1 is TCFD-aligned. Still referenced in EU Taxonomy and SFDR requirements.

governance.description: Board oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities; management's role in assessing and managing climate risks
keyQuestions: Does the board oversee climate-related risks?
Does management have a climate risk committee or designated officer?

strategy.description: Climate-related risks and opportunities and their impact on the organisation's business, strategy, and financial planning
keyQuestions: Are climate scenarios (1.5°C, 2°C, 3°C) used in strategic planning?
Are climate-related risks integrated into capex/opex decisions?

riskManagement.description: Processes used to identify, assess, and manage climate-related risks
keyQuestions: Is there a formal climate risk identification process?
Are climate risks integrated into the enterprise risk management (ERM) system?

metricsTargets.description: Metrics and targets used to assess and manage climate-related risks and opportunities
keyQuestions: Are Scope 1, 2, and 3 GHG emissions disclosed?
Are there science-based or Paris-aligned emission reduction targets?

climateRiskAssessment.description: Formal assessment of physical and transition climate risks for the facility
keyQuestions: Has a physical risk assessment (heat, flooding, water scarcity) been conducted?
Has a transition risk assessment (carbon pricing, regulatory change) been conducted?
